anya: Packaging detected a digest mismatch for private-vpc installer v1.8.0-rc2 on the mirror. Proposing hold for tonight's canary.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: private-vpc/installer v1.8.0-rc2 -> staging-canary @ 2026-03-25T22:00Z. Use /hold to pause or /rollback 1.8.0-rc1 to revert.
sam: Can someone confirm whether it's a signing/cosign issue or mirror cache?

anya: Quick local check: CI sha256 = c0ffeec0..., mirror sha256 = d34db33f... Looks like stale mirror blob.

ops-oncall: Cosign check: one shard signed before signer rotation (rotated 2026-02-28). Mirror didn't refresh.
maria: Agree hold. Plan: repackage with live signer, refresh shrinkwrap, sign, verify checksums, then reschedule.
lee: Rollback criteria: abort if >1% checksum failures in canary or any cosign mismatch. Also abort on >20% latency regression.
anya: Repackaging now with --no-cache and pinning signer. Will open PR to pin packager signer.
ops-oncall: Mirror republish underway, ETA ~20m. Will post final sha256 and cosign OK.
maria: I'll note the delay in release notes and add a one-liner postmortem about the signer rotation & cache.
sam: Use unique tag rc2-20260325-signed for artifacts to avoid confusion.
ops-oncall: Cosign verified and mirror checksums consistent: sha256 c0ffeec0... Reschedule proposed: 22:45Z.
lee: Reschedule ok. Please include postmortem note in release notes.
anya: PR opened: packager/pin-signer-20260325. Republish complete.
deploy-bot: Deploy rescheduled: private-vpc/installer v1.8.0-rc2 -> staging-canary @ 2026-03-25T22:45Z (tag rc2-20260325-signed).
